tokenize_dialog_for_llama3: tokenize a chat dialog using a Llama 3 tokenizer with proper label masking for system and user prompts
raft_tokenize_qa_pair: tokenize a question-answer pair with document context into a Llama 3 chat format for RAG fine-tuning
get_custom_dataset_from_json: load a JSON dataset, split it, and tokenize all samples using raft_tokenize for Llama 3 fine-tuning
check_header_in_token_seq: check if a system or user prompt header token sequence exists within a given token list
replace_target_tokens_with_ignore: replace all occurrences of a target 3-token sequence with -100 ignore tokens in a label sequence
